summary: Lets the scene pause this system. Plain `[Pausable]` follows `ECS.GameplayPaused`; `[Pausable(PauseGroup.Animation)]` follows `ECS.AnimationPaused`.
summaryText: Lets the scene pause this system. Plain [Pausable] follows ECS.GameplayPaused; [Pausable(PauseGroup.Animation)] follows ECS.AnimationPaused.
examples:
The following example shows a movement system that stops while the game is paused:

```csharp
[Pausable]
public class EnemyMovement : System { }

ECS.GameplayPaused = true; // EnemyMovement stops; rendering and UI keep running
```
